subject: pharmacology
title: Immunosuppressants II: Basiliximab, Belatacept, Antithymocyte Globulin and Antibody Nomenclature

steps.tx: **Basiliximab** is a chimeric monoclonal antibody against CD25, the interleukin 2 receptor alpha chain on activated T cells, given as two transplant induction doses (day 0 and day 4) to fence early acute rejection without depleting lymphocytes, billing little beyond rare hypersensitivity. Its gentleness contrasts **antithymocyte globulin** next step; induction choice is rejection risk arithmetic, not fashion.
steps.say: Basiliximab blocks the IL 2 doorway briefly and politely; risk decides if politeness suffices.

right.title: Induction selection
points: Sensitisation and donor type grade risk
Delayed graft function risk favours depletion

steps.tx: **Antithymocyte globulin** (rabbit ATG principally) polyclonally depletes T cells for high risk induction and steroid resistant rejection rescue, billing cytokine release fevers (premedicated, slow first infusions), serum sickness a week later, thrombocytopenia and prolonged lymphopenia with infection prophylaxis extended accordingly. Alemtuzumab (anti CD52) depletes deeper and longer in niches shadowed by autoimmunity paradoxes.
steps.say: ATG depletes first and apologises with fevers; prophylaxis calendars stretch to match its lymphopenia.

left.title: ATG territory
points: Dose by lymphocyte and platelet counts

steps.tx: **Belatacept**, a CTLA 4 immunoglobulin fusion blocking CD80 and CD86 costimulation (signal two), maintains kidney transplants without calcineurin nephrotoxicity as monthly infusions, billing higher early acute rejection, progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy fences, and absolute avoidance in EBV seronegative recipients (post transplant lymphoproliferative disorder risk). Its existence proves costimulation is a drug target, its fences prove targets have biologies attached.
steps.say: Belatacept spares kidneys by blocking signal two; EBV status decides who may receive the favour.

left.title: Belatacept offer
points: No calcineurin nephrotoxicity or metabolic ledger
Monthly IV maintenance after conversion rules
Better long term graft function in trials

steps.tx: **Muromonab** (OKT3), the murine anti CD3 antibody, was transplantation's first monoclonal and its cautionary tale: cytokine release syndrome severe enough to demand intensive premedication, human antimouse antibodies ending retreatment, and withdrawal from markets as safer depleters arrived. It survives in examinations as nomenclature origin (murine -monab) and as the reason first doses of depleting antibodies are events, not administrations.
steps.say: OKT3 taught transplant medicine that first antibody doses are events; its name survives in the suffix rules.

left.title: Muromonab history
points: Anti CD3 T cell depletion and modulation
Severe cytokine release with first doses

right.title: Modern inheritance
points: Humanised successors with gentler first doses
Cytokine release grading and tocilizumab era
Withdrawal where benefit risk was superseded

steps.tx: **Monoclonal antibody nomenclature** decodes every biologic prescription: stem -mab, source infix o (mouse), xi (chimeric), zu (humanised), u (fully human), with target syllables (li for immunomodulating, ci for cardiovascular, tu for tumour) historically embedded, so basiliximab reads chimeric immunomodulator and trastuzumab humanised antitumour before the chart is opened. Newer naming reforms simplify, but the legacy code covers the formulary.
steps.say: The suffix is a compressed datasheet: species, target and era in four letters.

steps.tx: **Interferons** close the immunomodulator shelf: interferon beta in multiple sclerosis (flu like injections, depression and thyroid surveillance), pegylated interferon alfa retired from hepatitis by direct antivirals but persisting in myeloproliferative niches, interferon gamma in chronic granulomatous disease, each billing flu like syndrome as the class signature and autoimmunity provocation as its paradox. They are cytokines as drugs, dosed like weather systems.
steps.say: Interferons are cytokine weather: flu like fronts, autoimmune squalls, niche sunshine.

steps.tx: **Sign consolidation**, the plan's flagged pair, deserve consolidation: gums enlarge under cyclosporine, phenytoin and calcium channel blockers (plaque control and drug swaps manage, gingivectomy rescues), while nephrotoxicity in this module spans calcineurin fibrosis, rejection mimics and every co prescribed nephrotoxin, arbitrated by levels and biopsy. Two signs, whole modules of differential, which is why examiners keep returning to them.
steps.say: Enlarged gums name three drug families; a rising creatinine in transplant names a biopsy.

right.title: Transplant creatinine arbitration
points: Rejection versus toxicity versus BK virus
Biopsy decides steroid or dose cut

steps.tx: **JAK inhibitors** (tofacitinib, baricitinib, upadacitinib) moved small molecule immunosuppression downstream of cytokine receptors across rheumatoid, bowel and skin disease, billing zoster, lipid and cardiovascular and malignancy warnings that reshaped their place after safety trials, with vaccination (recombinant zoster) preceding them. They are this module's bridge to modern rheumatology and its cautionary regulatory tale in one.
steps.say: JAK inhibitors brought oral cytokine blockade and a safety warning that reordered whole clinics.

right.title: JAK ledger
points: MACE and malignancy boxed warnings (class debate)
Lipids rise, counts and liver monitored
